--- create_index_interleave_named_schema.sql
CREATE INDEX AlbumsByTitle ON sch1.Albums(AlbumTitle), INTERLEAVE IN sch1.Singers
--- AST
&ast.CreateIndex{
  Rparen: 52,
  Name:   &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 13,
        NameEnd: 26,
        Name:    "AlbumsByTitle",
      },
    },
  },
  TableName: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 30,
        NameEnd: 34,
        Name:    "sch1",
      },
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 35,
        NameEnd: 41,
        Name:    "Albums",
      },
    },
  },
  Keys: []*ast.IndexKey{
    &ast.IndexKey{
      DirPos: -1,
      Lparen: -1,
      Rparen: -1,
      Name:   &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 42,
        NameEnd: 52,
        Name:    "AlbumTitle",
      },
    },
  },
  InterleaveIn: &ast.InterleaveIn{
    Comma:     53,
    TableName: &ast.Path{
      Idents: []*ast.Ident{
        &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 69,
          NameEnd: 73,
          Name:    "sch1",
        },
        &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 74,
          NameEnd: 81,
          Name:    "Singers",
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE INDEX AlbumsByTitle ON sch1.Albums(AlbumTitle), INTERLEAVE IN sch1.Singers
